title: Map advertised modes to conformance cases
scope: Create machine-readable capability-to-case obligations and revisioned result records.
acceptance: Every advertised mode has required lifecycle/physical cases or an explicit missing-evidence failure.
Compilation, execution, regression, physical quality and timing remain distinct scopes.
evidence: PASS: 54 Python conformance tests; all 49 canonical capability records match exactly one rule and invalid Cartesian combinations match none.
PASS: compiled conformance input, registry and comparator tests (3/3); manifest validates the hashed obligations profile.
PASS: relocatable SDK install/build/input checks and installed qualification validator; positive result qualifies 1/1 and missing rigid physical contract fails 0/1.
LIMITATION: most existing modes remain explicitly unqualified until exact lifecycle and analytic contracts are added; this task qualifies no production driver.
